verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the documented ability to flag a message for follow-up (outlook-docs-3), which covers the follow-up part of the story but only thinly. Nothing in the evidence describes snoozing, reminders that resurface a thread, or triggering on no reply. Missing for 10: snooze conversations, time-based reminders that resurface a thread, reminders conditional on nobody replying, in-depth docs, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies

citations.quote: app users can change the importance of a message (or event or task), or flag a message for follow-up
